notes: Static GLB roots already contain positions. Add directly without reapplying pose.
LOD0 GLBs embed PBR textures. LOD1/2 GLBs reference their own asset textures folder, avoiding duplicate image payloads.
Runtime assets include three real LODs for all 25 asset definitions. User texture pixels and prior flower models are preserved.
The glTF AO channel is material micro-cavity, not baked scene GI.
